Strips assume a 27 in (2.25 ft) wide roll. Always buy all rolls from the same dye lot.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the total wall length and the ceiling height.
  2. Enter your roll coverage (a US double roll covers about 56 sq ft).
  3. Read the rolls to buy, rounded up.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is the coverage of one roll?

A standard US double roll is about 20.5 in × 33 ft, covering roughly 56 sq ft. European rolls are usually 10.05 m × 0.53 m (about 57 sq ft). Check your roll label.

Does pattern repeat change the count?

Yes. Large repeats waste paper because each strip must start at the same point in the pattern. Add 1 extra roll for repeats over 12 inches.

Should I subtract doors and windows?

For small openings, no — the leftover strips are useful for above and below them. For large openings, subtract the area.
